purpose: Development-only Apple Foundation Model prompt selection; the next fresh corpus is reserved for one-shot cross-source evaluation.
selection_rule: Maximize valid proposals; tie-break by category accuracy, then fewer over-limit quotes. If still tied, keep the shorter prompt.

variants.prompt:
Classify the supplied synthetic document by its primary purpose. Choose exactly one allowed category. Use the category descriptions. Return the shortest useful evidence as an exact, contiguous quote copied from the document text. The quote must have no more than 20 whitespace-separated words and no more than 160 characters. Do not paraphrase or add words.
Finance: invoices, bills, receipts, payments, account statements, or reimbursements
Events: invitations, schedules, programs, tickets, or registration for gatherings and activities
Reference: manuals, instructions, technical guides, API documentation, or procedures
